"""Linux-only integration check using a pseudo-terminal, NOT the Bluetooth radio."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, os, pty, select, subprocess, time
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);parser.add_argument("--binary",required=True)
args=parser.parse_args();binary=Path(args.binary).resolve(strict=True)
master,slave=pty.openpty();device=os.ttyname(slave)
process=subprocess.Popen([str(binary),"--headless","--send-hello","--serial",device],
    cwd=binary.parent,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
os.close(slave);os.set_blocking(master,False);os.set_blocking(process.stdout.fileno(),False)
log=bytearray();received=bytearray()
def wait_until(predicate,timeout=5):
    deadline=time.monotonic()+timeout
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        if predicate():return
        ready,_,_=select.select([master,process.stdout.fileno()],[],[],0.05)
        for descriptor in ready:
            try:chunk=os.read(descriptor,4096)
            except (BlockingIOError,OSError):continue
            (received if descriptor==master else log).extend(chunk)
        if process.poll() is not None:break
    raise RuntimeError(f"PTY check timed out. stdout={log.decode('utf-8','replace')} serial={received!r}")
try:
    wait_until(lambda: b"hello\n" in received)
    encoded="你好，Orange Pi!\n".encode()
    for byte in encoded:
        os.write(master,bytes([byte]));time.sleep(0.005)
    wait_until(lambda:"Bluetooth RX: 你好，Orange Pi!".encode() in log)
    os.write(master,b"without-newline")
    wait_until(lambda:b"Bluetooth RX: without-newline" in log)
    if received!=b"hello\n":raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected echo/serial data: {received!r}")
    process.terminate();process.wait(timeout=3)
    if process.returncode!=0:raise RuntimeError(f"Unclean shutdown: {process.returncode}")
    print(log.decode("utf-8","replace"))
    print("PASS: Linux PTY integration (raw TX, fragmented UTF-8 RX, idle flush, no echo, clean stop).")
    print("Bluetooth pairing/radio and the physical screen remain unverified by this test.")
finally:
    if process.poll() is None:process.kill();process.wait()
    process.stdout.close();os.close(master)
